title: Collaboration, Workplace Practice Adoption, and Performance: Evidence from a Field Experiment
eligible_reason: Randomized controlled trial of about 5,000 Chilean SMEs with firm-level randomization stratified by visit month and cross-randomized email treatments. Main text analysis is ANCOVA (Y_jst = b1*Collaboration_js + g*Y_js0 + delta_s + e_jst) on cumulative outcomes. A difference-in-differences estimator appears only as a corroboration in Online Appendix Figure A.10, not in the main text.
design_notes: Main text Tables 3-5 report cross-sectional ITT estimates with baseline outcome controls and strata fixed effects; month fixed effects are deliberately excluded. Supplemental material (online appendix and data files) is referenced at an INFORMS DOI.
screener_notes: Ineligible: RCT with ANCOVA in the main text; the DiD is appendix-only and reflects a randomized pre/post comparison, not staggered adoption. Data availability inferred from the Supplemental Material line (data files at the INFORMS DOI); not verified.
